description: This file defines an interface for protocol adapter tests related to the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes default assertions for comparing external headers in WithDittoHeaders objects and a nested class for custom header assertions.

classes.name: ProtocolAdapterTest
classes.description: Interface for protocol adapter tests, providing default assertion methods and a nested class for specific header assertions.

classes.name: WithFilteredHeadersAssert
classes.description: Inner class extending AbstractObjectAssert, specialized for asserting equality of WithDittoHeaders objects with header filtering.

methods.name: assertWithExternalHeadersThat
methods.description: Creates an assertion object to compare WithDittoHeaders based on external headers only.

methods.name: <constructor>
methods.description: Constructor for WithFilteredHeadersAssert, initializing with a WithDittoHeaders object, header translator, and filter flag.

methods.name: isEqualTo
methods.description: Overrides assertion method to compare WithDittoHeaders objects, applying header filtering if needed.
